note: Open BLM dispersed camping on the dry lakebed north of Joshua Tree town, inside the block the national park maps between Sunflower, Reagan and Cascade roads; the land around it is private and closed to camping. Unpaved approach roads, no sites and no facilities: camp at least 300 ft from roads and pack out trash. A BLM permit is needed for a campfire. Expect dirt-bike and other off-road traffic on the lakebed. --Claude
